title: MoneyFact
description: A fact of money an app says to its center, with the token of the person who made it true. Sent again under the same key, it replaces what was said: an app keeps the amount of an invoice at what is still due, and of a commitment at what is still to pay. The center adds the facts up by project; it executes no payment and keeps no ledger.

key.description: The app's own key for this fact: one fact per app and key.

kind.description: invoiced: asked of a third party and still due. received: money that came in. committed: promised to a third party and still to pay (an order placed, a pay due). spent: money that went out.

amount.description: In the currency's smallest unit (francs for XOF, cents for EUR): an integer, never negative.

label.description: What it is, as a person reads it: « Facture F-0412 », « Bon de commande BC-0031 ».

project_id.description: The project of the center it belongs to; none for the organization's own running.

post.description: The post of the project's budget it counts against, by its name.

party_id.description: The third party of the center it concerns.

href.description: Where the piece that proves it is read, in the app.
